statement: A standard HID plus generic UAC gadget cannot be assumed to expose Xbox 360 proprietary XInput or its headset transport. Whether a particular consumer would see the UAC card or treat it as an Xbox controller is unverified.

applicability.revision: Linux mainline v6.11, v6.12 or v7.3 as pinned; family revision unmeasured
applicability.scope: Standard-HID virtualgamepad Xbox 360, not proprietary XInput or a physical reference; no host test.
